grammar_focus: consist of + 动名词(由…构成/在于)、be capable of + 名词/动名词(能够…)、be deprived of(被剥夺…)、every time 引导时间从句(每当/一…就)、it is + 形容词 + for sb to do(for sb 作不定式逻辑主语)(NCE4 该课源无独立 KS 页,考点由课文结构自取;IP:源为 Richard Carrington《Elephants》一段讲驯象两法与人象纽带的说明文,系版权作品——已用 100% 原创行文复述其要点、无引用原句;⚠️净化:原文强硬训练法含‘鞭打/带金属尖头的刺棒/象鼻磨破’等强制细节,已弱化为‘迫使/坚定而耐心的手’并聚焦温和法与情感纽带;题材=动物训练·净化后无害;美语化 behavior/favor;第四册第41课)
scene: 训练大象主要有两种方法,我们不妨称之为强硬法与温和法。强硬法只不过是让动物去干活,一小时又一小时地迫使它做人所期望的事。且不论其中的残忍,这也是个愚蠢的办法,因为它造就的是一头满怀怨恨的动物,日后很可能变得危险。温和法在早期需要多得多的耐心,却能造就一头快活、脾气好、愿意提供多年忠诚服务的大象。训练大象的首要之务,是给这头动物指派单独一名驯象人,由他全权负责。大象喜欢只有一个主人,就像狗一样,而且它们能表现出相当程度的个人情感。甚至有这样的故事:一些半驯的幼象,在因某种不可避免的变故被夺走自己的驯养员后,竟拒绝一切食物、忧郁而死。这类极端的说法多半得打个折扣看待,但它们确实点明了一条总的原则:大象与驯象人之间的纽带,是成功的关键。捕捉一头大象来训练,最划算的年龄是十五到二十岁之间,因为那时它差不多已能承担重活,可以立刻开始挣自己的口粮。但这个年龄的动物不易变得顺从,早期必须用一只坚定而耐心的手。仍被绳拴在树上的被捕大象,每当有人靠近,就又蹦又叫,头几天多半会因恐惧而拒食一切。有时会在近旁拴一头驯服的大象,给这头野的壮胆;多数情况下,被捕的大象会渐渐安静下来,开始接受喂食。当同时训练好几头大象时,惯例是把新来的一头安置在两头已训练得相当到位、更为安静的大象的栏位之间。随后就让它完全不受打扰,给足食物和水,好让它吸收新家的气氛,并看到同伴身上没有发生任何令它惊恐的事。当它终于能正常进食时,它自己那温和的训练便可以开始,训练者会耐心地去赢得动物的信任,用一句柔和、抚慰的话语来强化每一点小小的成功。

grammar_card.title: consist of doing / be capable of / be deprived of / every time / it is adj for sb to do
grammar_card.intro: ①consist of + 动名词,‘由…构成/在于…’。②be capable of + 名词或动名词,‘能够…’。③be deprived of,‘被剥夺/失去…’。④every time 引导时间从句,‘每当/一…就…’。⑤it is + 形容词 + for sb to do,it 是形式主语,for sb 是不定式的逻辑主语。

be capable of + 名词/动名词
plunges every time a man approaches

It is + 形容词 + for sb + 不定式
It is customary for it to be placed…

specialRules.rule: consist of(由…组成)接名词或动名词,不用被动语态;consist in 则表‘在于’。
be capable of、be deprived of、be responsible for 等‘形容词/过去分词 + 介词’搭配要整体记。
美式拼写:behavior(行为,英式 behaviour)、favor(偏爱,英式 favour)。本课已按美语写。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — At what point does the training of a captive wild elephant begin?
options: When it has settled in and is eating normally in its new home
After it has learned to carry heavy loads
Only when it is twenty years old

passage: There are two main techniques for training an elephant, which we may call the harsh and the gentle. The harsh technique simply consists of setting the animal to work and forcing it, hour after hour, to do what is expected of it. Apart from the plain cruelty of it, this is a foolish method, for it produces a resentful animal that at a later stage may well become dangerous. The gentle technique asks for far more patience in the early stages, but it produces a cheerful, good-tempered elephant that will give many years of loyal service. The first essential in elephant training is to assign to the animal a single mahout who will be entirely responsible for the job. Elephants like to have one master, just as dogs do, and they are capable of a considerable degree of personal affection. There are even stories of half-trained calves that have refused all food and pined to death when, by some unavoidable circumstance, they were deprived of their own trainer. Such extreme tales must probably be taken with a grain of salt, but they do underline the general principle that the bond between elephant and mahout is the key to success. The most economical age to capture an elephant for training is between fifteen and twenty years, for it is then almost ready to undertake heavy work and can begin to earn its keep straight away. But animals of this age do not easily become subservient, and a firm, patient hand must be used in the early stages. The captive elephant, still roped to a tree, plunges and screams every time a person approaches, and for several days it will probably refuse all food through fear. Sometimes a tame elephant is tethered nearby to give the wild one confidence, and in most cases the captive gradually quietens down and begins to accept its food. When several elephants are being trained at one time, it is customary for the new arrival to be placed between the stalls of two calmer captives whose training is already well advanced. It is then left completely undisturbed, with plenty of food and water, so that it can absorb the atmosphere of its new home and see that nothing alarming is happening to its companions. When it is at last eating normally, its own gentle training can begin, and the trainer works patiently to win the animal's trust, reinforcing every small success with a soft and soothing word.

stage5.stem: "The tough method simply consists ___ setting the animal to work."(consist __ doing,‘由…构成/在于…’,填那个介词)

stage5.stem: "Successful training consists of ___ a good relationship first."(consist of + 动名词,填‘建立’那个动词的动名词)
stage5.stem_cn: 成功的训练在于先建立良好的关系。

stage5.stem: "The gentle method consists of ___ patience in the early stages."(consist of + 动名词,填‘表现出’那个动词的动名词)
stage5.stem_cn: 温和法在于早期表现出耐心。

stage5.stem: "Elephants are capable ___ deep and lasting affection."(be capable __,‘能够…’,填那个介词)
stage5.stem_cn: 大象能表现出深厚而持久的情感。

stage5.stem: "A well-trained elephant is capable ___ many years' loyal service."(be capable __ + 名词,填那个介词)
stage5.stem_cn: 训练有素的大象能提供多年忠诚的服务。

stage5.stem: "These animals are capable of ___ their master's voice."(be capable of + 动名词,填‘认出’那个动词的动名词)
stage5.stem_cn: 这些动物能认出主人的声音。

stage5.stem: "Some calves pined to death when they were deprived ___ their own trainer."(be deprived __,‘被剥夺…’,填那个介词)
stage5.stem_cn: 有些小象被夺走自己的驯养员后,竟忧郁而死。

stage5.stem: "A captive must not be deprived ___ food and water for long."(be deprived __,填那个介词)
stage5.stem_cn: 被捕的大象不可长时间断绝食水。

stage5.stem: "No elephant should be ___ of the single master it trusts."(‘被剥夺…’这个结构,填‘剥夺’那个动词的过去分词)
stage5.stem_cn: 任何大象都不该被夺走它所信赖的唯一主人。

stage5.stem: "The captive plunges and screams ___ a man approaches."(‘每当…就…’,填引导时间从句的连词组)
stage5.stem_cn: 每当有人靠近,被捕的大象就又蹦又叫。

stage5.stem: "___ the mahout appears, the elephant grows calm."(‘每当…’,填时间连词组)
stage5.stem_cn: 每当驯象人出现,大象就安静下来。

stage5.stem: "The young elephant refuses food ___ it feels afraid."(‘每当…’,填时间连词组)
stage5.stem_cn: 每当害怕,小象就拒绝进食。

stage5.stem: "It is customary ___ the new arrival to be placed between two calm elephants."(it is + 形容词 + __ sb to do,填 sb 前那个介词)
stage5.stem_cn: 惯例是把新来的大象安置在两头安静的大象之间。

stage5.stem: "It is necessary ___ a single mahout to take full charge."(__ sb to do 结构,填 sb 前那个介词)
stage5.stem_cn: 必须由单独一名驯象人全权负责。

stage5.stem: "It is important for the trainer ___ win the animal's trust."(it is + 形容词 + for sb + 不定式,填不定式记号)
stage5.stem_cn: 训练者赢得动物的信任很重要。

stage5.stem: "To give a task or duty to someone is to ___ it."(“分配,指派”用哪个词)
stage5.stem_cn: 把任务或职责交给某人。

stage5.stem: "Feeling bitter and angry at unfair treatment makes one ___."(“愤懑的,充满怨恨的”用哪个词)
stage5.stem_cn: 因不公待遇而感到痛苦愤怒。

stage5.stem: "To make a feeling or belief stronger is to ___ it."(“强化,加强”用哪个词)
stage5.stem_cn: 使某种感受或信念更强烈。
